prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop landing-page direction comp, 16:9 landscape
Primary request: Render a high-fidelity first viewport plus the beginning of the next section for the Clinimed Odontologia website, edge to edge, crisp readable Portuguese, no browser frame. The offer must read instantly as a multidisciplinary dental clinic in Votuporanga with evaluation scheduling by WhatsApp.
Input images: Image 1 is the official Clinimed logo and must be recognizable. Image 2 provides only the real clinic’s horizontal architectural scale; remove every PLUG sign and all blue/yellow branding.
Concept: Clínica em Seção — the webpage is one inhabitable architectural cross-section, not a picture of a blueprint and not a split hero. A long cutaway clinic runs horizontally across the viewport: reception, consultation, orthodontics, implants, and children’s care appear as legible rooms along one continuous route. A lime daylight beam travels through the rooms and resolves into the appointment action at reception. Above, a single floating glass-bubble navigation reads “Início · Quem Somos · Tratamentos · Profissionais · Depoimentos · Blog · Contatos” and “Agende sua avaliação”.
Content: “Um só lugar. Todo o cuidado.” “Mais de 40 procedimentos com planejamento integrado e atendimento humanizado.” Room labels: “Avaliação”, “Ortodontia”, “Implantes”, “Estética”, “Clínica geral”. Primary action “Agendar pelo WhatsApp”. Include “Rua Itacolomi, 3142 · Votuporanga/SP” and “Seg. a sex. · 07h–19h”. Begin the next section with “Conheça cada ambiente do seu cuidado”.
Visual law: limewash ivory ground, deep charcoal-green section cuts, Clinimed green details, one luminous lime band, restrained architectural annotations, contemporary humane sans with tabular time labels. One dominant horizontal section; all other elements quiet.
Constraints: clearly functional website, not an architecture poster, no generic service cards, no tooth icons repeated, no invented credentials or awards, no extra logos, no watermark.
